standard_prerequisites.use: It makes pullback along a surjective etale $f : U \to X$ exact, so that the pullback of a submodule or a quotient is again a submodule or quotient.

core_obligations: Choose a scheme $U$ with a surjective etale morphism $f : U \to X$ (proof line 2161).
Record that $f^*$ is exact because it is a restriction functor, and that coherence can be checked after pulling back along $f$ (proof lines 2162-2167).
Apply the scheme case on $U$ to the pulled back submodule or quotient and descend the conclusion to $X$ (proof lines 2168-2171).
proof_roadmap: The surjective etale cover by a scheme (proof line 2161).
Exactness of pullback and locality of coherence (proof lines 2162-2167).
The scheme case, and descent (proof lines 2168-2171).
difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that on a locally Noetherian algebraic space the quasi-coherent submodules and quotients of a coherent module remain coherent (statement lines 2151-2158). The proof pulls the situation back along a surjective etale morphism from a scheme, where pullback is an exact restriction functor, invokes the locality of the coherence condition for that cover, and quotes the scheme case. The reduction to schemes through the exactness and locality statements is the substance, so the claim is H2.
